svg.title: Glider input and computed blue routing output
svg.text: Glider — input and computed blue-layer output
Circle = 0. Plus = 1. Both layers are viewed from above, at the same scale and orientation.
OUTPUT · 4×4 blue tiles at the junctions
Five live cells, padded with one ring of zero cells.
Each Life cell has four identical corner symbols.
Each blue tile copies its four inputs into four 2×2 groups.
Nine fixed X blockers per tile; separator width: 0.2L.
Orange example: the four adjacent corner inputs are copied into the matching orange-outlined output tile.
The output tile contains four copies of this arrangement.
This is routing only; the Life update rule has not yet been applied.
